description: Classic content for DRAGSTER and ZOOM ZOO (the v9 entries, unchanged) and, from TRACK-BREADTH part 3, the fourteen other race tracks a cold start reaches: per track its decoded data, tile columns, tile flags and BG1 tiles (track.NN.*, R-0046 observations 1-2), per scenery (track mod 14) its BG2 tiles, BG2 map and race palette (scenery.SS.*, `$82:DC20-DD84`), and the track name table (`$83:9FFA`). Every new entry is ROM content located by the loader's own directories; tools/unirally_lab/content/tracks.py v10_new_entries generates them. From SPECIAL-TILE-RESPONSE (v11): the two 48-byte signed height tables the corkscrew tile steps through ($00:8088 and, for a rolling rider, $00:80B8; R-0047). From LOCKED-TOURS (v12): the twenty race tracks of the five tours a cold start does not list (track.NN.* for 5, 6, 8, 9, 15, 16, 18, 19, 25, 26, 28, 29, 35, 36, 38, 39, 40, 41, 43, 44) and sceneries 1, 8 and 12 (tracks.v12_new_entries). From TILE-PAIRS-8-12-26 (v13): the loop tile's 17 signed x steps by loop step ($81:834C; R-0051). From HUNTER-EFFECTS (v14): the HUNTER tag effects' blink pattern ($83:D3BC) and the HUNTER opponent's sprite palette (asset 26, character 20 + 6, `$82:DDB0-DDBC`; R-0052). From FRONT-END-MAIN-MENU (v15): the content of the boot screens, the title and the main menu: seventeen assets of the directory at `$82:B332` (front-end.asset.NNN) and the tables the front-end code reads in place: the base palette, the text printer's character table, the main menu's text, the arrow's spin frames and columns, and the palette cycle's colours (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v15_new_entries; R-0054). From FRONT-END-1P-SETUP (v16): the rider menu's content: the riders' sprite palettes (assets 6-21; `$80:A72B` and the HDMA table `$80:CD84` are the same bytes), the riders' name records a cold start copies to SRAM (`$83:800C`), the menu's title (`$80:BCAF`) and the main menu decoration animator's tables (`$83:9AF9`) (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v16_new_entries; R-0055). From FRONT-END-1P-SETUP part 2 (v17): PICK TOUR's, PICK TRACK's and NOW PLAYING's content: the computer riders', medals', base and marker palettes (assets 22-26, 32-37), the medal and marker object tiles (`$07:D5D8`, `$07:C9D8`), the menus' text and tables, the tour names, the laps by track and the stunt events' qualifying scores (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v17_new_entries; R-0056). From FRONT-END-1P-CONTINUATION (v18): the one-run result screen's text (`$80:D187`) and trophies (`$80:D17B`) (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v18_new_entries; R-0057). From FRONT-END-LAP-RESULT (v19): the lap result screen's text: the headings, the graph's axes and times, and "laps on" the track (`$80:910F`), the record line (`$80:918F`) and the two riders' rows (`$80:91A1`, `$80:91B9`) (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v19_new_entries; R-0058). From FRONT-END-TOUR-END (v20): the medal award screen's assets (0x3B, 0x53-0x56, 0x5C, 0x64, 0x65), the medal's second art (`$09:A658`) and the award's tables (`$83:B120`) (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v20_new_entries; R-0059). From RACE-RIDERS-OPPONENTS (v21): the opponent's catch-up by track (`$83:C8B3`) and the riders' colour math on the race's BG3 ink (`$82:D4DC`) (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v21_new_entries; R-0061). From FRONT-END-ENDINGS (v22): the gold endings' assets (0x3C, 0x3E-0x43, 0x4C, 0x52, 0x57, 0x5E-0x63) and each tour's ending tables in bank `$83` (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v22_new_entries; R-0062). From HUNTER-ENDING (v23): HUNTER's gold ending's assets (0x00, 0x3A, 0x5D, 0x66-0x69, 0x6B-0x6F: the newspaper pages, the credits' colours and faces), the pages' HDMA tables (`$80:E37B`, `$80:E3A1`) and the credits' text, poses and objects (`$83:AE01`, `$83:AE12`, `$83:AE72`) (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v23_new_entries). From STUNT-EVENT-RACE (v24): the nine stunt events' content, per track its decoded data, tile columns, tile flags and BG1 tiles (track.NN.* for 2, 7, 12, 17, 22, 27, 32, 37, 42; their sceneries are already in the pack) (tools/unirally_lab/content/tracks.py v24_new_entries; R-0066). From STUNT-RESULT (v25): the stunt result's heads' colours (assets 0x26-0x39), its nine text streams (`$80:F2EA-F4B4`) and the tally's five cells (`$80:F7E7-F7FA`) (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v25_new_entries; R-0067). From STUNT-HUD (v26): NEON's scenery (track 42 in one-player play loads scenery 14: BG2 tiles, BG2 map, and a palette whose six-row block is asset 0xA6 six times, `$82:DC22-DCB4`) and the green levels its lighting moves towards (`$83:D1C3`, eight bytes) (tools/unirally_lab/content/tracks.py v26_new_entries; R-0068). From TWO-PLAYER-VS (v27): the four original rider-menu title streams for 2P and VS, including the VS second-choice overwrite at $80:C107 (tools/unirally_lab/content/front_end.py v27_new_entries; R-0071). The human-opponent result adds its fifth row from $80:D1DB (R-0071). The shared local continuation choices, VS CHAMPIONS header and row, and PICK CHALLENGER title come from $80:AE3F-AE80, $80:F9EE-FA5F and $80:C10E (R-0071). From OPTIONS (v28): the five-choice OPTIONS and RECORDS text streams and arrow-column tables at $80:B678, $80:B6CA, $80:D593 and $80:D5E1 (R-0072). The OPTIONS picker, warning, rename prompt and keyboard streams come from $80:D4C5, $80:C1DE, $80:C1AE, $80:D4D2 and $80:A4DB and the SELECT+Y+A instruction at $80:9C77 (R-0072). v32 (AUDIO-FIRST-RACE) appends the first race sound set: the race tables and first race song with their transfers, the race sample slot table, its nine further samples, the directory lengths through resource 62 and the announcement voice table (R-0076); no earlier payload changes.
